title: Layout shift survey of live www, core 16.66.0 (pin 3df16988), non-story pages

method.html: one plain GET per page (14 pages), served from disk for every load
method.core: live core and chunks served byte for byte from the git objects of pin 3df16988 (SRI intact); variant cores from local files with integrity removed in the routed HTML only
method.assets: Webflow css/js, Google fonts and jsDelivr from local caches; Webflow images, video and fonts cache or abort
method.browser: Chromium headless (Playwright), one browser at a time, fresh context per load, Math.random seeded the same on every load
method.cls: sum of every layout-shift entry until at least 4 s after load and 5 s after navigation start; entries flagged hadRecentInput are counted, see notes (no input is sent; Chromium flags early entries under isMobile emulation)

causes.what: Site head parity script moves the nav out of the members-only wrapper at DOMContentLoaded; signed out, the wrapper is display:none, so the nav (77 px at 1440, 119 px at 390) appears after the first paint and pushes the page down
causes.where: Webflow site head inline script tll-proto-parity-js-v1, navOut() and run(); repo copy src/site/live-2026-11-13/fonts/site-head.after.html:211 and :242-243 (identical to live)
causes.evidence: navOut off (HTML patch): /account 1440 0.3007 to 0.0170, /submit 390 0.1437 to 0.0000, /submit 1440 0.0552 to 0.0002, /account 390 0.0119 to 0.0000. Memberstack blocked and core blocked: no change.

causes.what: Core layer tll-page-heroes-v1 builds the page photos at DOMContentLoaded, after the first paint: /travelers faces row (phones) or two-column grid with the hero widened from 900 to 1232 px (1200 px and up); /the-map backdrop with padding-top 244 px on phones (hero 436 to 730 px) and the credit line; /for-expats side photo; /about filmstrip
causes.where: src/site-layers/tll-page-heroes-v1.js:159-161 (run at DOMContentLoaded), travelers() :138, map() :144 with the phone padding rule :88, about() :147 with :92, expats() :150 with :103; built into src/site-layers/tll-site-layers-v16.js:254-406
causes.evidence: Core without page-heroes (local core, integrity removed): /for-expats 390 0.0773 to 0.0034, /for-expats 1440 0.0391 to 0.0001, /about 1440 0.0365 to 0.0005, /about 390 0.0245 to 0.0036, /travelers 1440 control 0.3040 (local core) to 0.0589, /travelers 390 0.1134 to 0.0833 (other shifts remain). Frame trace: /the-map 390 hero 436 to 730 px at DCL; /travelers 390 faces list inserted, hero 355 to 490 px at DCL.

causes.what: Contributor profile script builds the profile head at DOMContentLoaded (it is the last script in the body); the CMS layout is painted first and then rearranged
causes.where: Contributors template page footer script tll-pf5-profile-js-v1; repo copy src/pages/contributors-template/after-2026-10-20/tll-pf5-profile-v1.js:199-204 (live differs only in one count label)
causes.evidence: Run at once instead of waiting for DOMContentLoaded: 1440 0.1178 to 0.0196, 390 0.0763 to 0.0035. hero() off: 0.0517 and 0.0177. Core, chunks, Webflow-hosted scripts, fonts, Memberstack, webflow.js blocked: no change.

causes.what: The Map 2.0 embed has no reserved height; after load it draws the map and its section grows from 37 px to about 2,500 to 4,300 px, pushing the passport block
causes.where: /the-map page embed (map-2.0, pin 46a21a18); repo copy src/pages/the-map/live-2026-10-25/embed-682054d4-after.html:5 (div#tll-map-layers, no min-height)
causes.evidence: Frame trace: section.tll-bg-bone 149 to 2,615 px at about 450 ms (1440) and 149 to 3,465 px (390). At 1440 this is the 0.067 shift after load in 5 of 5 loads. At 390 it is below the fold only because C2 pushed it there; without page-heroes it moves into view (0.11 median).

causes.what: Styles placed at the end of the body (page footer code) apply after a first paint when the paint comes early: /the-map passport block (tll-mp3-map-v1) grows from 146 to 371 px; /travelers search box (tll-trav-search-css) grows from 26 to 48 px and the cards reflow
causes.where: /the-map page footer, repo copy src/pages/heroes-2026-10-29/code/the-map-footer.html:171; /travelers page footer, src/pages/heroes-2026-10-29/code/travelers-footer.html:110
causes.evidence: Frame traces show the paint before the style and the growth when it is parsed. A race: 1 to 2 of 5 live loads; more often with the local core and at CPU 4x (/travelers 1440 0.204 median, 3 of 3 over 0.1). Moving every body style into the head did not help on its own because the same blocks are also rebuilt by scripts at DOMContentLoaded.

causes.what: /stories: the search form is moved into the filter row at DOMContentLoaded and the lead card is re-marked after; the chip rows move down 133 px
causes.where: /stories page footer tll-lib-lead-v1 merge() and mark(); repo copy src/pages/heroes-2026-10-29/code/stories-footer.html:191
causes.evidence: Frame trace: div.tll-lib-searchslot inserted, filters 124 to 257 px, chip rows 493 to 628 at about 350 ms; 4 of 5 loads (0.018). Grid grows 667 px at about 550 ms (lead card).

causes.what: /stories at 1440: the library title is 7 px shorter in Playfair Display than in the fallback face, so the search bar and chips move up 7 px when the web font arrives during parsing (this is the known 7 px race); worth 0.014, or 0.063 when more of the page was painted first
causes.where: Fallback faces in src/site-layers/tll-font-fallbacks-v1.html:22-27 (TLLSerifG/N/T size-adjust only, no line-height overrides) against the title rule in the /stories head
causes.evidence: Frame trace: h1 180 to 173 px at 228 ms, right after the Playfair woff2 (responseEnd 185 ms). 5 of 5 loads; the larger value in 1 to 2 of 5. Lab caveat: the local fallback fonts in this Linux container (Liberation, no Georgia) are not those of an iPhone or Android phone.

causes.what: /travelers rotating verb in the title (are, live, photograph, were) every 3.2 s; "photograph" makes the title wrap to three lines at 390 (81 to 121 px)
causes.evidence: Mutation log: em gets is-out at 3,397 ms and new text at 3,637 ms, title 81 to 121 px; shift 0.0128 at about 3.65 s in every 390 load (0.004 at 1440), repeats while the page is open. Not affected by blocking the core, chunks, fonts or webflow.js.

causes.what: Site head mobile nav script adds the Menu button to the nav at DOMContentLoaded (CTA row 254 to 320 px wide on phones)
causes.where: Webflow site head inline script tll-mobile-nav-js-v1; repo copy src/site/live-2026-11-13/fonts/site-head.after.html:141-153
causes.evidence: Mobile nav off: /about 390 0.0245 to 0.0108; with page-heroes also off 0.0002.

causes.what: Web font swap where the fallback face metrics differ (nav wordmark, /layovers verdict paragraph 158 to 132 px, /the-paw-passport steps, auth forms)
causes.evidence: Web fonts blocked: /layovers 1440 0.0147 to 0.0000, /layovers 390 0.0178 to 0.0034, /the-paw-passport 390 0.0220 to 0.0034, /the-paw-passport 1440 0.0080 to 0.0001. Lab specific magnitudes (local fallback fonts).
